sampling_note: Sampled results are draws from the exact statevector distribution via a seeded multinomial; they are NOT hardware measurements. Exact-statevector metrics are reported alongside and kept separate.

metric_definitions.feasible_normalized_score: (C_worst - E[C0 | feasible]) / (C_worst - C_best); null if no feasible mass or C_worst == C_best
metric_definitions.optimal_solution_probability: probability mass on any globally optimal feasible portfolio

known_limitations: Single synthetic 12-asset instance; exhaustive search is the true reference.
Classical greedy already attains the exact optimum; SA matches it, so no quantum advantage is demonstrated.
Sampled metrics come from exact-statevector multinomial draws, not hardware.
QAOA parameters are optimised with COBYLA; Method A uses an exact subspace simulation in the loop and a Qiskit circuit only for validation.
Circuit depths reported are logical (StatePreparation and PauliEvolutionGate are opaque), not transpiled depths.
This validation report was regenerated in targeted mode; the n=12 Method A reference check is subject to a 600 s wall-clock timeout and is labelled per depth.
